error.name: PAYOUT_NOT_AVAILABLE
error.message: You live in a country that is not allowed to send this payout.

payouts.rootCause: PayPal Sandbox Business account sb-kmpmt53795647@business.example.com has Country/Region set to India (IN). PayPal Payouts API is geographically restricted by PayPal policy to merchant accounts in supported countries (e.g. US, UK, EU, CA).
payouts.resolutionRequirement: Create a PayPal Sandbox Business Account with Country set to United States (US), generate app credentials under that US Business account, and retry Payouts dispatch.
